room_rent.note: Standard A/C room (single occupancy, attached washroom, excludes suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals as per policy wording Section C1(b).

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available as optional discount. If Cashless Discount cover opted, 20% co-pay applies on reimbursement claims.

sub_limits.note: Inbuilt cataract sub-limit: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹50,000. Optional 'Procedure/Disease Sub-limit' cover adds caps on cardiac, joints, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, gall bladder, spine, cancer, kidney, liver disease etc.

deductible.note: No deductible in base plan. Voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹10,000–₹3,00,000 available as optional discount.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for all illnesses except accidents. Not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required for PED. Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability norms.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, organ transplant, hysterectomy, calculi, joint surgeries, etc. Not applicable for accidents.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: Inbuilt CB: 10% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces at same rate on claim. Optional Super Cumulative Bonus available: up to 200% of SI at 25%/yr or 50%/yr.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional cover. Options: once per policy year or unlimited times per policy year. Subsequent hospitalisation must be after 2-day gap from discharge (waived for different insured). Not available for organ donor or modern treatment claims.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission for same illness/injury.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge for same illness/injury.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list of 399+ procedures in Annexure I. Any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI if patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available, must exceed 3 days. Excludes asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis, vector-borne diseases, psychiatric disorders, etc.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation (min 24 hrs) covered up to In-patient SI. Excludes OPD, comfort treatments, spa/resort packages.

organ_donor.note: Organ harvesting expenses for donor covered up to In-patient SI when insured is the recipient. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor excluded. Reinstatement benefit not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered at reasonable & customary charges up to In-patient SI for emergency transfer and inter-hospital transfer. Claim payable only if In-patient/Day Care claim accepted.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy for haematological conditions, etc.) covered up to In-patient SI. Cumulative Bonus and Reinstatement not applicable for this cover.

consumables.display: Not covered (excluded via non-medical items list)
consumables.note: Non-medical consumables listed in Annexure II are excluded. No optional consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only. Any medical expenses outside India are excluded.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except for established fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for quarterly/half-yearly/annual premium; 15 days for monthly instalment. Coverage available during grace period if instalment paid.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period at inception only (not on renewal or porting).

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines. Apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, domiciliary excludes diabetes/hypertension/asthma, no maternity, external congenital anomalies, no OPD

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus, Disease Sub-limits, Accidental Death Cover, Cashless Discount, No Claim Discount
